function.name: list_roll_tables
function.description: List roll tables in the world. Filter by name substring.

function.name: roll_on_table
function.description: Roll on a table. Foundry performs the roll. Returns the drawn result, the dice that produced it, and the resolved creature quantity. Does NOT display to chat.

function.name: get_compendium_actor
function.description: Fetch one statblock by explicit ID from a named pack. Single lookup only. There is deliberately no way to search all compendiums.

function.name: propose_encounter
function.description: Emit an encounter proposal card for the GM. Does not place anything. Write BEATS the GM can perform from, never prose.

quantity.description: Comes from roll_on_table's resolved quantity. If you computed this yourself, that is a bug (§5.3).

descriptor.description: e.g. 'lean, winter-starved'. A phrase, not a sentence.

beats.description: §5.3 says 3 to 5 fragments. This is enforced here so a prose-writing model fails validation instead of reaching the GM.

hook.description: One line. Why is this here? What does it imply about the world?

function.name: place_encounter
function.description: Place tokens on the active scene at the GM's cursor. Only callable after the GM accepts a proposal. Imports the world Actor first if needed.
